title: 第四十章 邪修自爆玄稷被埋入深渊第三十九章 加了血的九转丹成
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: “我们炼制的，凭什么都给你！”
玄稷一脸愤怒的瞪着邪修。
邪修见这小娃果然忍不住吐露了真话。
他就说，以他的观察，绝对是没错的。
“拿来！”
邪修说着，不想再跟玄稷墨迹，另一手直接吸过小胖，死死掐住小胖的脖子。
但凡玄稷敢不给，下一刻他就敢扭断这猫的脖子。
玄稷确实被他威胁到了，只好委委屈屈，眼眶都红了很是不甘心的，把手中的那颗丹药递了出来。
“快放了我的小胖！”
玄稷把丹药直接一丢，邪修慌忙去接，也就下意识放了被他掐着的小胖。
玄稷赶紧把小胖报过来，心疼的不行，心里对邪修的愤怒也是达到了顶点。
小胖感受到主人的愤怒，神识传音安慰她。
“喵~没事的主人喵~”
玄稷也在心神联系小胖道：“对，很快我们就能报仇了！”
大胖和壮壮它们早就围过来。
而这时，邪修又朝着秦征弋要他手里的那一颗九转丹了。
秦征弋直接飞出了洞府。
邪修下意识就上去追。
玄稷和大胖他们也乘机飞出地底，邪修见秦征弋不听，就要抓玄稷威胁。
秦征弋早就料到停下来，一手捏着丹药放在嘴唇边。
“如果你敢动我乖徒，我现在就吃了它！”
邪修当然不想让秦征弋把那一粒丹药给吃了。
本来有一粒的时候，他想着自己吃了，修为就可以冲到大乘期。
但是有三颗丹药，修为突破大乘的机会可不是就增加了三层那么简单，他自然不会放过。
“你想怎么样？”
邪修知道秦征弋到现在没吃那粒丹药，就是想跟他谈条件。
“放我们离开，这颗丹药给你。”
你先把丹药给我。”
秦征弋丝毫不让。
“你看我有那么傻吗？
你先放我徒儿离开，这颗丹药肯定少不了你的。
反正我们跑的也没你快，只要你不再追赶我们。
但如果你还想要挟持我们，那这颗丹药我会吃了，说不定我修为先到大乘期，届时你可就不是我的对手了。”
content_en:
"We will give you whatever we refine!"
Xuan Ji glared at Xie Xiu with an angry expression.
When Xie Xiu saw this little kid, he couldn't help but tell the truth.
He said that based on his observation, it was absolutely correct.
"Bring it!"
Xie Xiu said, not wanting to talk to Xuan Jimoji anymore, he directly sucked Xiaopang with his other hand and strangled Xiaopang's neck.
If Xuanji dared not give it, the next moment he would dare to break the cat's neck.
Xuan Ji was indeed threatened by him, so he had no choice but to feel aggrieved. His eyes were red and he was unwilling to hand over the pill in his hand.
"Let my little fat go!"
Xuan Ji threw the elixir away, and Xie Xiu hurriedly went to pick it up, and subconsciously let go of the little fat man who was being pinched by him.
Xuan Ji hurriedly reported Xiaopang over, feeling extremely distressed, and the anger in his heart towards the evil cultivator had reached its peak.
Xiaopang felt the anger of her master, and her spiritual consciousness comforted her.
"Meow~ It's okay, Master, meow~"
Xuan Ji also mentally contacted Xiaopang and said, "Yes, we will get revenge soon!"
Big Fat and Zhuangzhuang had already gathered around them.
At this time, the evil cultivator asked Qin Zhengyi for the Nine Turns Pill in his hand.
Qin Zhengyi flew out of the cave directly.
The evil cultivator subconsciously went after him.
Xuan Ji, Da Pang and the others also took the opportunity to fly out of the ground. Seeing that Qin Zhengyi refused to listen, the evil cultivators wanted to arrest Xuan Ji and threaten him.
Qin Zhengyi had expected to stop, holding the pill to his lips.
"If you dare to touch my good disciple, I will eat it now!"
Of course the evil cultivator didn't want Qin Zhengyi to take that pill.
When he had one pill, he thought that if he took it, he would be able to reach the Mahayana stage.
But with three pills, the opportunity to break through the Mahayana cultivation level is not as simple as increasing by three levels, so he will naturally not let it go.
"What do you want?"
The evil cultivator knew that Qin Zhengyi had not taken the pill until now, so he just wanted to negotiate terms with him.
"Let us leave. I'll give you this elixir."
"Okay!
Give me the elixir first. "
Qin Zhengyi refused to give in at all.
"Do you think I'm that stupid?
You let my disciple go first. You will definitely need this elixir.
Anyway, we can't run as fast as you, as long as you stop chasing us.
But if you still want to hold us hostage, then I will take this pill. Maybe my cultivation will reach the Mahayana stage first, and you will not be my opponent by then. "
title_en: Chapter 40: The evil cultivator blew himself up and Xuanji was buried in the abyss. Chapter 39: The Nine-turn Pill with added blood.
